name: Square Sandbox App
description: Square Sandbox App is an isolated test application environment with separate seller accounts, locations, credentials, API origins, simulated resources and payment values.
agentUseSummary: This testing environment is visible as a canonical Square provider-family security preview. Relay will not collect sandbox tokens, mix them with production connections or expose payment simulation as an agent runtime.

capabilities.label: Test a Square connector in the sandbox
capabilities.description: If sandbox execution is approved, extend only a canonical Square connector with immutable environment, app, seller, location, scope and origin binding.

blocked.label: Create duplicate Square provider state
blocked.description: A sandbox listing must not create a parallel token, tool or approval surface beside Relay's typed Square connectors.

blocked.label: Capture Square sandbox credentials
blocked.description: Relay will not ask a developer to paste a full-access personal sandbox token or scoped sandbox OAuth token into this Marketplace alias.

blocked.label: Mix sandbox and production authority
blocked.description: Sandbox origins, apps, accounts, locations, tokens and resources must never be accepted by a production Square connection or vice versa.

blocked.label: Simulate Square payments as an agent action
blocked.description: Creating test payments, cards, refunds, orders or other financial scenarios is explicit developer testing outside Relay agent actions.

blocked.label: Run Square actions from the setup alias
blocked.description: This alias exposes no runtime actions; approved sandbox testing must be a separate non-production target that reuses typed connector bounds and audits.

approvalProfiles.label: Square sandbox isolation review
approvalProfiles.description: This testing alias is not connectable. Sandbox credentials and payment simulation remain unavailable until a canonical connector has an isolated non-production execution target.

runtimeSupport.description: This alias installs no OpenClaw tools; sandbox support must extend a canonical Square provider pack in an isolated non-production target.
This alias installs no Hermes tools; sandbox support must extend a canonical Square provider pack in an isolated non-production target.

providerSetup.blocker: Square Sandbox is isolated from production but includes application credentials, seller test accounts, locations and full-access or scoped bearer tokens. Default sandbox tokens have unrestricted sandbox authority, and payment simulation can create financial-looking state. Relay does not accept sandbox credentials or mix test and production connections.
providerSetup.nextAction: For approved testing, extend only the relevant canonical Square connector with a separately provisioned non-production target, immutable sandbox origin/app/seller/location binding, scoped OAuth rather than the default full-access token, synthetic-only data rules, payment limits, teardown, audit and hard denial of every production credential and resource.

evidence.supports: Square describes the Sandbox as an isolated environment with separate origin, credentials, accounts, resources and test values that cannot cross into production.
Square distinguishes full-access personal sandbox tokens from scoped sandbox OAuth tokens and production credentials, and identifies locations as separate bound resources.
Square requires OAuth application credentials, URLs and seller tokens to match the target environment and states Sandbox is only for testing.
Square provides special sandbox-only payment values and predictable success or failure scenarios; valid payment cards and card-present testing are not supported.
